title: New exponent pairs, zero density estimates, and zero additive energy estimates: a systematic approach
relevant_concepts: Sargos C and D processes recorded as Lemmas 13-14
notes: arXiv:2501.16779 (25 January 2025). Four new exponent pairs: (89/1282, 997/1282), (652397/9713986, 7599781/9713986), (10769/351096, 609317/702192), (89/3478, 15327/17390). For the two-monomial functional phi = (5/4)p + q of docs/theory/exponent_pair_two_monomial.md the smallest of these is 4433/5128 ~ 0.864, above Bourgain's 95/112. The paper also records the Sargos C and D processes used in Theorems 6-8 of that note.
